answer: The dune detector writes to glacier, and mirror publishes every merge. Submissions that land within 147 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 42 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 31 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
